name: TelegramTradeNotify
summary: This EA is a Telegram notification utility that monitors trade activity on an MT5 account and sends real-time alerts to a Telegram chat via the Bot API. It tracks trade events such as new positions, modifications, and closures, forwarding detailed trade information to the configured Telegram bot. It does not open any positions itself.
summary_zh: 这个EA是一个Telegram通知工具，监控MT5账户的交易活动，并通过Telegram Bot API实时推送交易提醒。它跟踪新建仓位、修改和关闭等交易事件，将详细交易信息转发到配置的Telegram聊天中，自身不执行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略，而是一个交易通知工具。其核心功能是监控账户交易事件变化，包括新开仓、加仓、减仓、平仓和订单修改等。当检测到交易活动变化时，EA会构造包含交易详情的消息文本，如交易品种、方向、手数、价格、盈亏等信息。然后通过HTTP POST请求调用Telegram Bot API，将消息发送到指定的聊天ID。该工具不涉及任何入场或出场策略逻辑，也不进行仓位管理或资金管理。其价值在于让交易者能够远程实时了解账户交易动态，特别适合使用VPS进行自动化交易的用户。整体设计属于辅助工具范畴，主要依赖OnTimer或OnTrade事件来触发检测逻辑。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a trade notification utility. Its core function is monitoring account trade event changes, including new position openings, additions, reductions, closings, and order modifications. When trade activity changes are detected, the EA constructs message text containing trade details such as symbol, direction, lot size, price, and profit/loss information. It then sends the message to a specified chat ID via HTTP POST requests to the Telegram Bot API. The tool does not involve any entry or exit strategy logic, nor does it perform position sizing or money management. Its value lies in enabling traders to remotely monitor account trading dynamics in real time, which is especially useful for users running automated trading on VPS. The overall design falls under the auxiliary utility category, primarily relying on OnTimer or OnTrade events to trigger detection logic.

pros: 实时远程监控账户交易活动，方便VPS用户随时掌握动态
利用Telegram Bot API实现免费可靠的消息推送，无需第三方服务
通知内容详细，包含交易品种、方向、手数、价格等关键信息
安装配置简单，只需填入Bot Token和Chat ID即可使用
不干扰现有交易策略运行，纯粹的监控工具
pros_en: Enables real-time remote monitoring of account trading activity, convenient for VPS users
Leverages the free and reliable Telegram Bot API for message delivery without third-party services
Detailed notification content including symbol, direction, lot size, price and other key information
Simple setup requiring only Bot Token and Chat ID configuration
Non-intrusive pure monitoring tool that does not interfere with existing trading strategies
cons: 依赖网络连接和Telegram服务可用性，网络异常时通知会丢失
Bot Token和Chat ID等敏感信息以明文参数存储，存在安全隐患
缺乏消息发送失败的重试机制和错误恢复处理
高频交易场景下可能产生过多通知导致消息轰炸
没有本地日志记录功能，无法回溯历史通知记录
cons_en: Depends on network connectivity and Telegram service availability; notifications are lost during network outages
Sensitive credentials like Bot Token and Chat ID are stored as plaintext parameters, posing security risks
Lacks retry mechanism and error recovery handling for failed message deliveries
May produce excessive notifications leading to message spam in high-frequency trading scenarios
No local logging functionality to retrospectively review historical notification records
improvements: 增加消息发送失败的重试机制和本地消息队列缓存
对Bot Token等敏感信息进行加密存储或从安全文件读取
添加通知频率限制和消息去重功能，避免重复通知骚扰
improvements_en: Add a retry mechanism and local message queue caching for failed message deliveries
Encrypt or securely read sensitive information like Bot Token from a protected file
Implement notification rate limiting and message deduplication to prevent notification spam

risk_points: Bot Token明文存储存在泄露风险
网络中断时无法发送通知但不会影响交易账户安全
risk_points_en: Plaintext storage of Bot Token poses a leakage risk
Network interruptions prevent notifications but do not affect trading account safety
